tasks.title: Review retained complaint evidence
tasks.objective: Inspect the retained observations and cluster memberships before treating the opportunity as a product requirement.
outputs: Reviewed problem statement and evidence traceability notes
acceptance_criteria: Every product requirement links to one or more retained complaint IDs
Coverage gaps and restricted display modes remain visible
tests: Evidence identifiers and policy display rules are checked

tasks.title: Research competitors and contrary signals
tasks.objective: Verify direct products, adjacent tools, workarounds, and weak-market signals instead of inferring them from complaints.
acceptance_criteria: Each competitor relation has a permitted provenance route
Unresearched market dimensions are recorded as unresolved gaps
tests: Missing competitor coverage cannot be rendered as negative evidence

tasks.title: Define the smallest product wedge
tasks.objective: Turn the reviewed problem statement into a bounded first wedge with explicit non-goals and policy-aware architecture boundaries.
outputs: MVP scope, architecture direction, and dependency-aware tasks
acceptance_criteria: The wedge addresses a named cluster without expanding to unrelated problems
Deletion, privacy, and operational work are included in the scope
tests: Task dependencies are acyclic and every task has acceptance criteria

tasks.title: Validate implementation readiness
tasks.objective: Prove the proposed wedge against replayable evidence, deterministic scoring, security boundaries, and operational limits before release.
outputs: Passing tests, failure-drill evidence, and an explicit release decision
acceptance_criteria: The implementation can be reproduced from the package without hidden chat context
Open source, retention, and deployment blockers are not marked complete
tests: Contract, replay, security, and failure-recovery tests pass
